heroHeadline: Afghanistan Claims 41 Militants Killed Crossing from Pakistan as Border Clashes Escalate
heroSubtitle: Afghanistan's Defence Ministry reported September 30 that security forces killed 41 militants attempting to cross from Pakistan, raising the death toll from a similar September 27 incident in which 28 fighters were killed. Islamabad denied government ties to the armed groups. The incidents follow Pakistan's September 24 airstrikes on 10 sites in Kandahar, Paktia and Khost — which Afghan officials said killed four civilians — and Taliban spokesman Zabihullah Mujahid's warning of an 'appropriate response.'
